scope: Theorem 1.5 (Weaker decay in dimensions three and four) of the manuscript “The spacetime Penrose inequality and enclosing area” (preprints/The-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-and-enclosing-area-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9bb0c350914915db), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n = 3 or n = 4. Let (Ωn, g, K) be the smooth one-ended exterior specified above, with integrable constraint densities, finite ADM limits, dominant energy condition and weakly future trapped boundary. Assume g − δ = O2(r−q ), K = O1(r−1−q ), q > n − 2 2 . Then Amin,g(S) > 0, E > |P|δ, and (1.5) holds.
